description: This header file defines macros and documentation for creating 'commit slabs,' which are data structures associating data with commits in a version control or dependency system. It includes boilerplate code for defining such slabs for different data types, as well as functions for initializing, accessing, and clearing these slabs.

methods.name: define_commit_slab
methods.description: Macro that declares and implements static functions for managing a commit slab data structure associated with a specific element type.
